title: Regional BDR Team Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are expanding our sales and field engineering teams globally, including our sales development representative (SDR) teams. Our SDRs are typically outstanding graduates from STEM fields who would like to join the software industry and are starting their sales career at Canonical.

We are hiring SDR Team Managers to run new inbound and outbound teams. Our goal is not only to manage inbound leads for a global tech company, but also to develop outstanding sales professionals with high integrity, high empathy and a rigorous work ethic. Our sales development organisation is therefor also sales academy, and as such, we are looking for SDR Team Managers who take a strong interest in the development of skills and the establishment of culture.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, hard-working, and care to ensure that smart and ambitious people learn and develop the skills they need to represent you and the company in outstandingly well over the course of their career - both while they are on your team, and as they move onward to more senior sales and alliances positions. You should be determined to grow your own skills as well as those of your team, and enjoy learning about new technologies. Canonical is fortunate to represent the vast wave of open source innovation, which means it has a large and rapidly growing range of solutions it can deliver to customers, and ample opportunity for all of us to learn about new kinds of tech, or specialise in fields we enjoy the most. You should also be open to innovation, and experiment with new outbound approaches to adapt to changes in the market. In this role your primary objective is to manage and mentor a successful team of 2-10 SDRs / BDRs, and maintain a multi‑million dollar pipeline.

We value:

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for business development, sales and technology
  • Track record of bringing exceptional outbound sales development results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement – curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration
  • Leadership experience of one form or another
  • Able to use data to drive team activities and continuous improvement

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Our client is a China-based IoT and telecommunications solutions provider with a global footprint. The position is not technical and not end-customer sales.

  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills
  • Fluent English for daily communication with international teams
  • Comfortable working in a new role with high autonomy

Nice to Have

  • Experience with A2P SMS platforms or messaging services
  • Exposure to international wholesale markets
  • Chinese (not mandatory, but a plus)

Why Join

  • Newly created role with high visibility and growth potential
  • Opportunity to work in a global, international environment
  • Direct exposure to telecom operators and international markets
  • Be part of the LATAM expansion of a global telecom and IoT player

title: Corporate Communications Senior Manager
description:
Corporate Communications Senior Manager

Department: Communications

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Corporate Communications Senior Manager will lead strategic planning and delivery of communications and public relations strategies and activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring the tournament is powerfully positioned in line with FIFA’s overall strategic objectives and the FIFA Women’s Football Strategy.

This role is responsible to support the Head of Communications & Media Relations in the rollout and implementation of the Communications components of the tournament’s Marketing & Communications Strategy, with a strong focus on Brazil and South America. The position plays a central role in leading the development and implementation of proactive corporate communications that enhance FIFA’s reputation, raises awareness on the tournament, influences public perception, engages with internal and external stakeholders for higher impact and ensures consistency across proactive and reactive messaging at a global level.

Reporting jointly to the Head of Communications & Media Relations based in Brazil and to the Team Lead Corporate Communications in Switzerland, the Corporate Communications Senior Manager will collaborates with senior stakeholders, decision-makers, and leadership teams to translate corporate priorities and tournament objectives into engaging, credible narratives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and implement a corporate communications-first approach, delivering proactive, strategic messaging and storytelling across Brazil and South America in line with the Marketing & Communications Strategy.
  • Develops messaging for tournament milestones, events, initiatives, campaigns, announcements and key FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ functional areas.
  • Act as the central integrator for communications-related matters, coordinating internal and external stakeholders including FIFA27 functional teams, Host City communications teams, federal, state and municipal authorities, the CBF, and other key partners.
  • Develop and implement pre‑emptive communications plans to manage risk, address sensitive topics and engage targeted audiences.
  • Develop issues and crisis communications planning and execution within FIFA27 in close alignment with the FIFA Communications Division, supporting all relevant partners and activities in the lead‑up to and during the tournament.
  • Build close working relationships with other Marketing and Communications teams to ensure narrative unity and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with the Media Relations department to identify and amplify proactive stories that shape public understanding of FIFA’s initiatives.
  • Partner with digital, editorial, and campaign teams to deliver integrated storytelling across FIFA’s ecosystem,
  • Perform other duties directly related to the role, as required by FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ leadership or the FIFA Communications Division.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 7 years experience in communications, media and public relations, with experience in similar leadership positions
  • Familiarity with the world of football. Passion for women’s football is a plus
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Spanish language skills are an asset
  • Able and willing to travel up to 50% of the year
  • Able and willing to work non‑traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package. Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted.

Position Description

We are seeking a Field Compliance Coordinator to join our Upstream OE & Compliance Division. The OE & Compliance Division is responsible for providing safety support to Upstream Executive Management and various other organizations through HSE reporting, conducting safety audits, creation of safety recommendations, human factors guidance, delivery of safety training, facilitation of major incident investigations and creation of lessons learned. Your primary role is to support Upstream organizations on Process Safety and major Incident’s investigations matters while focusing on employees from Onshore and Offshore drilling and oil & gas processing plants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enhance safety standards and general procedures such as work permit, process safety, hazard identification, risk management, emergency preparedness etc.
  • Develop loss prevention, fire prevention and safety standards, procedures and General Instructions (GIs) for matters not already addressed by existing resources.
  • Provide advice and consultation to Upstream management as requested to facilitate Safety Management System (SMS) enhancement.
  • Develop critical safety documents for major activities such as job safety analysis and hazards identification plans.
  • Assist departments in preparing for major safety review such as loss prevention compliance reviews.
  • Research emerging safety technologies and conduct feasibility studies and cost analyses to identify improved solutions to existing safety problems and emerging regulatory requirements.
  • Act as an audit expert in process safety for risk identification and mitigation during design, construction, commissioning, turn-over to operations, on-going operations, management of change and decommissioning of facilities.
  • Develop and deliver safety training material and safe work procedures to the field personnel.
  • Instruct on safety concepts, practices and standards (both on-the-job and classroom based).
  • Direct and participate in the preparation of major reference manuals documenting corporate and LP safety systems, policies, and procedures (e.g., LP Policy, SMS manual, Safety Handbook, Construction Safety Manual). Reviews related high-level documents from other organizations or outside parties with potential to impact the safety of company operations as required.
  • Facilitate and lead incident investigations including interviewing witnesses, gathering data and conducting a root cause analysis.
  • Facilitate and lead safety audits by identifying areas of non-compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and advise on how to improve existing conditions.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, HSE or equivalent from an accredited university.
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience working in upstream organizations that have diversified operation from exploration, drilling and producing in both onshore and offshore including at least 5 years in a senior position as a Loss Prevention or Fire Prevention subject matter expert.
  • Strong technical expertise in the area of process safety, e.g., design engineering, loss control management, hazard identification, hazard and operability (HAZOP) reviews, incident investigations, emergency preparedness and response and safety management systems.
  • Experience in HAZOP and safety integrity level (SIL) studies is preferred with internationally recognized certifications.

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is a plus
  • 5+ years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in estimating, project controls, and data analytics)

Skills

title: Ad Ops Onboarding Manager - Publishers (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente deEducon - Educação Médica Continuada ,para trabalhar de formahíbrida no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Ao assumir o cargo de Analista Administrativo Pleno na Afya, seu objetivo principal será de auxiliar o coordenador de venda Field Sales, compreensão de funil de vendas, processo de captação e de matrícula, acompanhamento de projetos agilizar a resolução de eventuais erros e implementar melhorias no processo e rotinas do comercial. Realizando interface diária com as áreas que fazem parte do processo decaptação vendas, consultores Field Sales, Backoffice comercial, Financeiro, Secretária acadêmica e unidades.

♿ Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

  • Apoiar diretamente a coordenação de Field Sales, atuando como braço estratégico na organização, análise e acompanhamento do funil de vendas.
  • Acompanhar o processo de captação e matrícula, garantindo fluidez, prazos e qualidade da informação do início ao fechamento.
  • Monitorar indicadores do funil (visitas, interesses, propostas e matrículas), identificando gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Realizar o preenchimento, atualização e controle de planilhas gerenciais, assegurando a confiabilidade dos dados comerciais.
  • Consolidar informações de diferentes fontes (CRM, relatórios, áreas internas) em planilhas de acompanhamento e controle.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios e análises para suporte à tomada de decisão da coordenação comercial.
  • Atuar na gestão e acompanhamento de projetos comerciais, contribuindo para organização, execução e entrega dos resultados esperados.
  • Agilizar a resolução de erros operacionais (cadastros, contratos, financeiro, acadêmico), atuando de forma preventiva e corretiva.
  • Implementar melhorias em processos, rotinas e controles comerciais, propondo soluções que aumentem eficiência, produtividade e conversão.
  • Realizar interface diária com as áreas envolvidas no processo de vendas: Consultores Field Sales, Backoffice Comercial, Financeiro, Secretaria Acadêmica e Unidades.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre áreas, clareza de informações e suporte para que o time comercial foque no que mais importa: vender com qualidade e impacto na formação médica.

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em rotinas administrativas ou posições de suporte à área comercial, preferencialmente em ambientes de vendas consultivas.
  • Vivência com gestão, controle e acompanhamento de custos, garantindo organização, conformidade e eficiência operacional.
  • Experiência na criação, organização e manutenção de documentos regulatórios, políticas, normas e regulamentos internos.
  • Experiência na elaboração, acompanhamento e análise de KPIs, com foco em relatórios gerenciais que apoie na tomada de decisão do coordenador e gerente.
  • Domínio de planilhas e controles gerenciais, sendo desejável Excel em nível avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, consolidação de dados).
  • Experiência com utilização de CRM, realizando acompanhamento de funil, organização de dados e suporte às rotinas comerciais.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida, com presença de até 10 dias presenciais por mês, conforme unidade local correspondente.

❤️ GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time.

Confira os principais abaixo:

Para o dia a dia:

  • Vale-alimentação / refeição;
  • Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas);
  • Vale-transporte (para vagas Hibridas ou Presenciais);

UP na remuneração:

  • Multibenefícios: Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir.
  • Gympass / Wellhub;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
  • Rede D'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
  • Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);
  • Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).

Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado:

  • Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);
  • Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes;
  • Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA);
  • Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.

✍️ Diferencial para Professor Médico:

  • Step 3: Etapa Atração 3 Etapa Atração

O MAIOR ECOSSISTEMA DE EDUCAÇÃO E SOLUÇÕES PARA PRÁTICA MÉDICA DO BRASIL.

A marca Afya nasceu em 2019, mas nossa história começou muito antes. Surgimos da união entre a NRE Educacional, maior grupo de faculdades de Medicina do país, fundado em 1999, com a MEDCEL, marca de cursos preparatórios para prova de residência médica.

Com o nosso crescimento acelerado, adquirimos nos últimos anos novas unidades de ensino — já são mais de 30 espalhadas pelo Brasil — e mais de 10 startups que oferecem soluções digitais para a prática médica — Afya Whitebook, Afya iClinic, Afya Papers, Glic e Cliquefarma são algumas marcas do nosso portfólio. Acesse afya.com.br para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos.

A Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto desde 2019, com ações negociadas na bolsa de valores Nasdaq, nos Estados Unidos. Em 2023 disponibilizamos nossas ações também na bolsa brasileira, a B3. Saiba mais sobre esse assunto em ir.afya.com.br .

Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. Para isso, contamos com um time de 10 mil pessoas curiosas, parceiras, comprometidas, adaptáveis e realizadoras. Gente de todos os cantos do Brasil, com diferentes sotaques, mas falando a mesma língua, unida pelo mesmo propósito. Se você se identifica com o jeito Afya de ser, vem com a gente transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia . #VemSerAfya

title: Analista de Projetos I
description:
Descrição

O profissional atuará de forma estratégica, com foco em análise de dados e otimização de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional e sucesso dos projetos da organização. Será responsável por desenvolver indicadores, análises estatísticas e mapeamento de processos, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e propor soluções inovadoras, incluindo aplicação de tecnologia. Atuará no planejamento e acompanhamento de projetos, dimensionamento de recursos, gestão de riscos e aplicação de metodologias de priorização de projetos, apoiando a gestão do portfólio, garantindo alinhamento com stakeholders e resultados consistentes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver indicadores e análises estatísticas para monitoramento de processos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e eficiência operacional;
  • Realizar dimensionamento de recursos (horas, pessoas, materiais, insumos e equipamentos), apoiando o cálculo de capacidade e utilização;
  • Aplicar metodologias de priorização de projetos (ex.: G.U.T., RICE, entre outras), apoiando a gestão do portfólio;
  • Identificar, registrar e acompanhar riscos, impactos e dependências, elaborando planos de mitigação em conjunto com os responsáveis;
  • Conduzir apresentações periódicas de status (comitês), garantindo transparência da evolução e alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Realizar mapeamento e modelagem de processos (BPMN 2.0), identificando gargalos e propondo melhorias contínuas;
  • Mapear processos relacionados às atividades fins da organização e/ou aos processos de suporte da mesma;
  • Acompanhar a implantação de novos projetos e controlar o desenvolvimento das atividades dos processos, com o objetivo de verificar o cumprimento das metas condicionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de aplicação de TI, prospectando soluções tecnológicas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharias, Administração de Empresas ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão, tais como Notion, MS Project e Lucidchart;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Análise de Dados e Storytelling com Dados;
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis e/ou híbridos (Scrum, Kanban, ou modelos mistos);
  • Experiência com gestão de projetos e processos, construção e acompanhamento de indicadores complexos e gestão de portfólio;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, com habilidade para interagir tanto com times operacionais quanto com a alta liderança.

title: Técnico(a) de Manutenção Volante
description:
O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Ensino técnico completo em Elétrica, Mecatrônica ou Controle e Automação com técnico em Elétrica.
  • Conhecimento em manutenção de instalações elétricas de força e comando em baixa tensão (quadros de distribuição, energia estabilizada, no-breaks, iluminação e QGBTs – quadros gerais de baixa tensão).
  • Conhecimento das normas NBR 5410, 5419, 14039, NR 10 e NR06. Manobra e manutenção de subestações elétricas e cabines primárias. Operação e manutenção de grupos geradores a óleo diesel. Liderança de equipes de manutenção em atividades complexas de manutenção predial.
  • Conhecimento em operação e manutenção de sistemas de climatização por expansão direta e indireta (chiller, fan-coils, rooftops, splits e PMOC).
  • Operação e manutenção de equipamentos contra incêndio: sprinlkers, moto-bombas, hidrantes, iluminação de emergência e central eletrônica de alarme com detecção de fumaça.
  • Curso de segurança básica em Instalações Elétricas (NR 10).
  • Curso complementar de SEP (Segurança no Sistema Elétrico de Potência).
  • Curso de mecânica de refrigeração e climatização.
  • Curso de gestão e planejamento da manutenção (TPM, PCM e RCM).

Como é o Dia a Dia

  • Realiza controles técnicos de manutenção que já está em funcionamento, atuando em todas as disciplinas instaladas, detalhando com propriedade os riscos e propostas de correção, com base nas normas brasileiras, projetos e técnicas de manutenção (TPM, RCM e PCM).
  • Estabelece plano de ação para redução dos riscos em conjunto com as equipes residentes de loja / CD.
  • Contribui para o conforto e segurança dos nossos clientes internos e externos, executando projetos de melhorias das instalações de loja (elétrica, ar, ventilação, pci e ilum. específica), cuidando do planejamento das atividades, análise de projetos e cronogramas, acompanhamento técnico de campo durante a execução e recebimento dos serviços com qualidade, respeitando o projeto inicial, prazo, custo e às normas internas da LEROY MERLIN, do Brasil e Internacionais.
  • Implantar os contratos de manutenção preventiva obrigatórios, sendo responsável polos contratos de Civil, Elétrica, Hidráulica, Incêndio, Gerador, Ar Condicionado e equipamentos de mobilidade.
  • Contribui continuamente na capacitação e estruturação das equipes prestadoras de serviços de manutenção na loja, elevando o grau de domínio da equipe sobre o tema manutenção, consolidando uma cultura de prevenção, segurança e conforto.
  • Planeja e controla a manutenção, acompanhando o cronograma de atividades estabelecido no programa de manutenção LMB, respeitando o prazo e a qualidade nas atividades.
  • Implementa, em conjunto com as equipes de lojas e com as empresas contratadas, os procedimentos de manutenção (relatórios, TAGs e OS's de atendimento), ferramentas e instrumentos de trabalho, além da organização da oficina de manutenção e da área de utilidades, em conformidade com o padrão LEROY MERLIN.
  • Soluciona problemas de engenharia, emergenciais, crônicos ou intermitentes, (operacional ou de segurança de pessoas) e reduzir continuamente a frequência de falhas em sua região (utilizar as ferramentas RCM, TPM e PCM), liderando tecnicamente planos de ação com as equipes de lojas e empresas de manutenção, para a resolução das falhas que impactam nas vendas, na segurança de pessoal e do patrimônio.
  • Contribui para o planejamento dos investimentos anuais da LMB na área da engenharia, apoiando o Gerente de Manutenção.
  • Identifica as necessidades de retrofit ou de adequação das instalações perante as normas brasileiras, com detalhamento técnico, orçamento e justificativas para o investimento.
  • Contribui para a redução dos gastos de manutenção corretiva e o prazo de entrega das peças de reposição, por meio da avaliação e certificação de novos fornecedores regionais para contratos de manutenção, implantação de novas metodologias no fornecimento, compra dos materiais de manutenção e fornecimento de peças, além do cumprimento integral das manutenções preventivas planejadas.

Obrigado pelo seu interesse em fazer parte da nossa construção! Desejamos boa sorte no seu processo! Não deixe de visitar uma loja e conhecer ainda mais sobre como é fazer parte do nosso time, vendo de perto as pessoas que entregam as melhores experiências para nossos clientes.

Incentivamos a diversidade e a inclusão, por isso, todas as vagas estão disponíveis para Pessoas com Deficiências (PcD).

Seja parte essencial da construção de um futuro melhor para o mundo. Seja LEROY MERLIN! #ConstruimosOFuturo

Fique à vontade, a casa é sua!

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um(a) DevOps Pleno para atuar na sustentação e evolução da nossa infraestrutura tecnológica, apoiando o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis, resilientes e seguras. A pessoa profissional atuará em conjunto com times multidisciplinares, contribuindo para a automação de processos, melhoria de performance dos sistemas e evolução das práticas de CI/CD.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais Atividades:

  • Compreender as necessidades dos projetos, considerando infraestrutura e ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, propondo soluções alinhadas às estratégias de negócio.
  • Desenvolver e manter ferramentas de provisionamento, configuração, deploy e monitoramento em ambientes escaláveis.
  • Manter e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD, seguindo boas práticas de segurança de código.
  • Planejar e executar capacidade de infraestrutura, com foco em eficiência e controle de custos em AWS.
  • Implementar e aprimorar monitoramento e observabilidade do ambiente.
  • Projetar novas arquiteturas e analisar o desempenho de sistemas existentes, buscando otimização e ganho de performance.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com cultura e práticas DevOps.
  • Experiência em migração de ambientes on-premises para cloud pública.
  • Experiência com infraestrutura para aplicações críticas em cloud.
  • Vivência com AWS (ELB, AWS Backup, EKS, Lambda, Route53, Secret Manager, RDS e DynamoDB).

  • Conhecimento em linguagens voltadas ao ecossistema DevOps (Shell, Python ou Golang).
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (EKS).
  • Experiência na construção de pipelines e boas práticas de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Zabbix, ElasticSearch, Kibana, Grafana) e noções de APM.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código utilizando Crossplane.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de Helm Charts.
  • Experiência com Bitbucket Pipelines.

De segunda à sexta-feira, de 9h às 18h

title: Administrador de Contratos - Exclusivo para PCDs
description:
Você se destacaria em uma função onde organização, atenção aos detalhes e suporte administrativo são essenciais para garantir o bom funcionamento das atividades do time?

Você traria proatividade, compromisso e colaboração para apoiar processos e rotinas em um ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados?

Junte-se ao nosso time!

Na Baker Hughes, acreditamos que a eficiência administrativa é fundamental para o sucesso das nossas operações. Nossa equipe oferece suporte essencial às áreas internas, garantindo a execução ágil, precisa e alinhada aos nossos padrões organizacionais.

Trabalhe com os melhores!

Como Administrador de Contratos (Exclusivo PcD) , você será responsável por apoiar todas as etapas de administração dos contratos, antes e depois da assinatura. Isso inclui garantir que os Termos e Condições sejam cumpridos e ajudar na gestão de reclamações.

Você também irá definir, organizar e executar atividades de análise de riscos para apoiar contratos e projetos. Além disso, será responsável por estimar custos para auxiliar em propostas e revisões de projetos.

No dia a dia, você contribui para o planejamento operacional anual do departamento e da equipe, além de sugerir melhorias em produtos, processos e procedimentos.

Como Administrador de Contratos (Exclusivo PcD), suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Assegurar a rentabilidade e a satisfação dos clientes nos contratos sob sua gestão.
  • Gerenciar contratos de serviços e programas baseados em tempo e material.
  • Apoiar campanhas de vendas relacionadas a novos contratos e propostas comerciais.
  • Garantir a resolução rápida de problemas dos clientes, mantendo altos níveis de satisfação nos contratos atribuídos.
  • Colaborar com equipes de atendimento ao cliente, peças e serviços transacionais, serviço de campo, reparo e demais áreas internas.
  • Atuar como ponto de ligação entre as equipes internas e os clientes dos contratos sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com profissionais da unidade de negócios, alinhando atividades, planejamentos e esclarecendo questões técnicas quando necessário.
  • Seguir processos padronizados de projeto, utilizando diretrizes estabelecidas para a tomada de decisões. Possuir autonomia moderada para organizar o próprio trabalho e planejamento.
  • Atender clientes-alvo com base em contratos e estruturas previamente definidas, com alguma flexibilidade para ajustes quando necessário.

Para ter sucesso nesta função você precisa ter:

  • Formação superior em instituição reconhecida (preferencial) ou ensino médio/GED com no mínimo 4 anos de experiência na área de Serviços.
  • Habilidade comprovada no uso de ferramentas de informática, incluindo Word, Excel e PowerPoint.
  • Conhecimento prévio do setor de óleo e gás.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto verbal quanto escrita.
  • Forte capacidade de relacionamento interpessoal e liderança.
  • Autonomia para trabalhar de forma independente.

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here is what we offer:

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Conduct NIH-funded research on RNA-based gene regulation in Staphylococcus aureus, a gram-positive bacterial pathogen prone to cause multi-drug-resistant bloodstream infections. The specific focus will be on small proteins, small RNAs, and tRNA modifications. The postdoctoral research fellow will lead experiments investigating RNA–RNA and RNA–protein interactions in bacterial stress adaptation and virulence.

Supervisory Authority

Dr. Karl M. Thompson, Ph.D. – Associate Professor and University Biosafety Officer

Nature and Scope

This is a lab-based research position in molecular microbiology. The Fellow will:

  • Perform functional studies of small protein and RNA function and interactions using a combination of molecular genetics (mutants, over-expression, gene-fusions, two-hybrid constructs); biochemical and biophysical tools (e.g., AUC, MST, SEC-MALS).
  • Conduct RNA stability assays, RIP-seq, and bacterial genetics.
  • Collaborate on in vivo studies and murine infection models.
  • Contribute to mentoring, manuscript writing, and data presentation.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Design and execute experiments on RNA regulators and stress-response pathways.
  • Analyze and interpret data from RNA-protein and RNA-RNA interaction assays.
  • Generate and characterize mutant bacterial strains.
  • Maintain detailed lab records and uphold research rigor.
  • Support manuscript and grant preparation.

Core Competencies

  • Strong background in molecular microbiology and RNA biology.
  • Experience with RNA-binding assays, RIP/qPCR/seq, and transcript stability analysis.
  • Familiarity with protein–RNA interaction techniques and bacterial genetics.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.

Minimum Requirements

  • PhD in Microbiology, Biochemistry, or related field.
  • Track record in RNA biology or microbial gene regulation.
  • Hands‑on experience with relevant molecular techniques.
  • Prior S. aureus or Gram-positive pathogen work preferred.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$50,000-$60,000

  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies and innovations for delayed coker/visbreaker improvement and optimization.

Qualifications

title: Associate Manager, Human Resources
description:
Associate Manager, Human Resources – Location: Barra da Tijuca

The Associate Manager, Human Resources – Field HR plays a key role in implementing HR strategies and initiatives within a designated manufacturing site or location. This position is responsible for supporting a broad range of HR functions, including employee relations, onboarding, talent and leadership development, change management, diversity and inclusion, performance management, workforce planning, and compensation processes. As part of the Field HR team, this role partners closely with the business to ensure the effective delivery of HR programs and initiatives across the organization, driving alignment between people strategies and operational goals.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with BU HRBP to provide proactive guidance, communications, and HR generalist support to employees within a respective manufacturing plant and/or site
  • Ensure consistent application of HR policies / procedures and local laws and practices
  • Execution of HR programs and processes, managing different priorities concurrently through project management, systems knowledge, and effective communications
  • Support team members in the implementation of HR initiatives within the manufacturing plant/site
  • Partner with HR Operations team and the COE’s to ensure consistent execution of HR policies, initiatives, and approaches within the manufacturing plant or site
  • Gathers, organizes, and analyzes feedback from individuals and teams
  • Support HR team in resolving HR operational issues
  • Support change management programs and initiatives
  • Lead the implementation and/or execution of applicable training programs
  • Support employee engagement initiatives and cultural programs
  • Support special projects and related duties
  • Lead the full cycle recruitment process for Production roles
  • Support the non-production Talent Acquisition Process and onboarding
  • Support compensation process
  • Ensure policies and processes are compliant with local law and regulations (including Union relationship)
  • Support Labor Relations Strategy within a country.
  • Support the delivery of Talent Management & Organizational Effectiveness programs such as PMP, MS&D, GPTW, GEOS, etc.
  • Additional responsibilities are listed in the Global Process Catalog.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Knowledge of general HR policies, procedures, and HR leading practices and applicable laws / regulations in country of employment
  • Ability to interact with colleagues of all levels to gather information
  • Ability to work well in a team environment and prioritize work appropriately
  • Ability to work effectively in an environment of change and manage multiple priorities concurrently through project management, systems knowledge, and effective communication
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office software
  • Minimum of a bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Human Relations, or related discipline
  • 15 years of HR generalist experience and/or related fields
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing environment preferred

PREFERED SKILLS

  • Consulting and Advising: Advancing initiatives and mandates through consultation with client groups, relationship building, while ensuring alignment to corporate strategies.
  • Employee Relations: Applying an understanding of labor legislation, regulations, and employee relations practices to the management of the formal, legal employment relationship between the organization and its employees
  • Human Resources Management: Applying an understanding of human resource management (HRM) practices, policies and principles.
  • Recruitment and Selection: Providing advice and services related to attracting, sourcing (advertising, job fairs etc.), evaluating (determining and implementing selection criteria and strategy), interviewing and the intake (i.e. negotiating offers) of appropriate talent to meet the organization’s human resources needs.
  • Customer Focus: Providing service excellence to internal and/or external customers.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Full-Time
  • Percentage of travel time expected: less than 10%
  • Remote work once a week for eligible employees (4x1);
  • This position is not eligible for relocation;
  • Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice as assigned by the Manager.

BENEFITS AND PERKS

SC Johnson’s total compensation packages are at or above industry levels. In addition to salary, total packages may include bonuses, long-term incentives, matching 401(k) contributions and profit sharing based on company profitability, job level and years of service. As a family company, we’re committed to providing benefits such as subsidized health care plans, maternity/paternity/adoption leave, flexible work arrangements, vacation purchase options, recreation and fitness centers, childcare, counseling services and more.

ABOUT US

SC Johnson (SCJ) is a family company working for a better world. It's this essence that drives all its activities around the world for 135 years. Throughout its history, it has established itself as one of the leading global manufacturers of household brands, offering high-quality products in hygiene, cleaning, home storage, air fresheners, pest control, among others. In Brazil, its portfolio includes recognized brands such as Pato®, Mr. Músculo®, Lysoform®, Glade®, Raid®, OFF!®, Baygon®, and Ziploc®.

INCLUSION & DIVERSITY

We’re a global business, with people from every culture, ethnicity, race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age and ability. We recognize the breadth of human experience, and we work to celebrate it. It is our goal to build a diverse, inclusive and supportive work environment where all people can thrive. Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Network Manager (NWM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The NWM will understand the stadia legacy network ensuring it will support FIFA’s needs during the FWWC 2027. Certifications & Requirements

Job Description

The position

Reporting organizationally to the FIFA27 Head of Competition Management and Team Services (Brazil) and FIFA Competition Management (Zurich), the Senior Competition Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Competition Management (CPM) team. Working closely with and under the guidance of the FIFA Competition Management project team, the role is responsible for delivering the highest standards of competition, tournament and match operations in Brazil before and during the FWWC27, as well as for FIFA test events and other relevant tournaments and events.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and manage Competition Management activities in Brazil, reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Competition Management and Team Services in Brazil, and FIFA Competition Management in Zurich.
  • Act as the main counterpart to FIFA Competition Management core project team in Zurich.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders, including government bodies, football communities and relevant institutions, to ensure successful delivery of objectives.
  • Ensure strategy, planning, coordination and implementation of competition area and stadium readiness is in line with FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines.
  • Recruit, manage and oversee the locally based Competition Management team, including staffing, planning, training, administration and integration into stadium venue teams.
  • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of FIFA27 Competition Management team before and during FWWC27.
  • Manage budgeting, tracking and cost control for Competition Management, ensuring regular reporting to FIFA27 and FIFA Zurich.
  • Representing Competition Management at key meetings and inspections whenever necessary.
  • Plan and deliver competition‑related events, workshops and seminars in collaboration with FIFA Competition Management team (including test events, draw(s), and official FIFA workshops). Ensure regular reporting to the Local Entity’s management and maintain clear and efficient communication with all functional areas and external partners.
  • Monitor competition areas during venue construction or refurbishment to ensure compliance with FIFA standards and follow up on all associated requirements.
  • Plan and deliver stadium and competition readiness exercises, including development of training materials.
  • Ensure stadium and team equipment requirements are met (e.g. team materials, field of play equipment), including procurement coordination with Stadium & Infrastructure, Pitch Management, and Team Services.
  • Prepare progress reports and presentations on Competition Management matters.
  • Representing Competition Management at the Tournament Operations Centre during event time, ensuring effective communication and reporting to FIFA HQ Competition Management Project Lead and Head of Competition Management and Team Services.
  • Support the recruitment, training and coordination of Competition Management volunteers.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sports Management or Event Management (master’s degree is an asset).
  • Minimum 6 (six) years of experience in football and event management; international experience is preferred.
  • At least 4 (four) years of experience in Competition Management (football and match operations).
  • Strong knowledge of international football.
  • Proven experience in competition and match operations, as well as sports venue operations.
  • Solid understanding of event planning and project management processes.
  • Knowledge of the local culture and operational environment in Brazil is an advantage.
  • Strong administrative and IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Ability to monitor performance and implement decisive corrective actions.
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain highly qualified employees.
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem‑solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, negotiation and relationship‑management skills, with high energy and a proactive mindset.
  • Experience of managing multi‑disciplined teams across a variety of business areas.
  • Ability to work effectively in an international, dynamic and demanding environment.
  • Ability to adapt and work with people from different cultures and backgrounds.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken); any additional language skills (in particular Spanish and French) are an asset.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Senior Manager, Competition

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the FIFA27 Head of Competition Management and Team Services (Brazil) and FIFA Competition Management (Zurich), the Senior Competition Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Competition Management (CPM) team. Working closely with and under the guidance of the FIFA Competition Management project team, the role is responsible for delivering the highest standards of competition, tournament and match operations in Brazil before and during the FWWC27, as well as for FIFA test events and other relevant tournaments and events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and manage Competition Management activities in Brazil, reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Competition Management and Team Services in Brazil, and FIFA Competition Management in Zurich.
  • Act as the main counterpart to FIFA Competition Management core project team in Zurich.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders, including government bodies, football communities and relevant institutions, to ensure successful delivery of objectives.
  • Ensure strategy, planning, coordination and implementation of competition area and stadium readiness is in line with FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines.
  • Recruit, manage and oversee the locally based Competition Management team, including staffing, planning, training, administration and integration into stadium venue teams.
  • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of FIFA27 Competition Management team before and during FWWC27.
  • Manage budgeting, tracking and cost control for Competition Management, ensuring regular reporting to FIFA27 and FIFA Zurich.
  • Representing Competition Management at key meetings and inspections whenever necessary.
  • Plan and deliver competition-related events, workshops and seminars in collaboration with FIFA Competition Management team (including test events, draw(s), and official FIFA workshops). Ensure regular reporting to the Local Entity’s management and maintain clear and efficient communication with all functional areas and external partners.
  • Monitor competition areas during venue construction or refurbishment to ensure compliance with FIFA standards and follow up on all associated requirements.
  • Plan and deliver stadium and competition readiness exercises, including development of training materials.
  • Ensure stadium and team equipment requirements are met (e.g. team materials, field of play equipment), including procurement coordination with Stadium & Infrastructure, Pitch Management, and Team Services.
  • Prepare progress reports and presentations on Competition Management matters.
  • Representing Competition Management at the Tournament Operations Centre during event time, ensuring effective communication and reporting to FIFA HQ Competition Management Project Lead and Head of Competition Management and Team Services.
  • Support the recruitment, training and coordination of Competition Management volunteers.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor's degree in Sports Management or Event Management (master’s degree is an asset).
  • Minimum 6 (six) years of experience in football and event management; international experience is preferred.
  • At least 4 (four) years of experience in Competition Management (football and match operations).
  • Strong knowledge of international football.
  • Proven experience in competition and match operations, as well as sports venue operations.
  • Solid understanding of event planning and project management processes.
  • Knowledge of the local culture and operational environment in Brazil is an advantage.
  • Strong administrative and IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Ability to monitor performance and implement decisive corrective actions.
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain highly qualified employees.
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, negotiation and relationship-management skills, with high energy and a proactive mindset.
  • Experience of managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas.
  • Ability to work effectively in an international, dynamic and demanding environment.
  • Ability to adapt and work with people from different cultures and backgrounds.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken); any additional language skills (in particular Spanish and French) are an asset.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are searching for a Senior Information Security Officer (SISO) who will provide leadership and oversight for cybersecurity operations within a designated secure enclave supporting federally sponsored research. The selected incumbent will be responsible for ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of enclave systems, networks, and data, including Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), in accordance with federal cybersecurity requirements and institutional policies.

SUPERVISORY ACCOUNTABILITY

Exercises functional supervision over enclave-assigned security personnel, which may include Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), system administrators, and compliance support staff. Coordinates enclave security activities with central IT and institutional information security offices. Authority is limited to the assigned enclave.

NATURE AND SCOPE

This position operates within a defined secure enclave and does not carry institution-wide cybersecurity authority. The incumbent is accountable for enclave-specific compliance with applicable federal regulations and standards, including NIST SP 800-171, CMMC Level 2, and DFARS requirements, supporting Department of Defense and other federal research programs.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Serves as the senior information security authority for the assigned secure enclave and has advisory authority over enclave system administrators.
  • Implements and maintains enclave-specific cybersecurity policies, procedures, and controls.
  • Develops and maintains System Security Plans (SSPs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), and required security documentation.
  • Prepares for DoD assessments, internal audits, and sponsor reviews.
  • Oversees enclave-level risk assessments, vulnerability management, and continuous monitoring activities.
  • Leads incident response activities within the enclave and coordinates escalation as required.
  • Ensures appropriate access controls, system configurations, logging, and boundary protections are in place.
  • Ensures alignment with institutional security architecture and enterprise risk management.
  • Coordinates with principal investigators, program managers, and administrative offices to support sponsor cybersecurity requirements.
  • Ensures secure handling, storage, transmission, and disposal of CUI within the enclave.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Knowledge of federal cybersecurity standards and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience with secure enclave architectures and network segmentation.
  • Cybersecurity risk management and incident response capabilities.
  • Ability to interpret and apply technical security requirements in research environments.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across technical and administrative units.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in information security or cybersecurity.
  • Experience supporting secure or regulated computing environments.
  • Knowledge of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) handling requirements.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, if required.
  • Preferred certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, CCSP, or Security+, which are commonly expected for an enclave security leadership.

Special Note

  • Resume/CV and cover letter should be included with the online application.
  • Due to U.S. Export Control laws and regulations, the candidate hired will need to be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or other "protected individual" (as defined by 8 U.S.C. Sec. 1324b(a)(3).)

You’ll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands‑on, high‑accountability role where flawless work is non‑negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers , detail‑obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets .

Part time to start, no. of hours/week can be negotiated during the initial interview, with possibility of transitioning to full time
Schedule: CET working hours
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Compensation: $2400-$3680 for full time

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Modelling (Forecast & Scenario Analysis)
    Build fully linked 3-statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management).
    Create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation-ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).

  • Historical Restatement & Data Hygiene
    Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis‑ready formats.
    Maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.

  • Reporting Templates & Automation
    Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks.

  • Transaction Support (Model-Led)

    Translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.

  • Quality Assurance & Standards

    Double-check every formula, input, and output — your work must be flawless .
    Ensure transparency through consistent assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A , ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique .

    • Candidates with more years of experience will also be considered if they remain flexible and open to new approaches.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to explain the story behind the numbers.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self-check work before submission.

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).

  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.

  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions ; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.

How Our Client Works

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

O profissional será responsável por pesquisar, desenhar e orientar a implementação de soluções de ponta para proteger a organização contra ameaças cibernéticas avançadas, com foco especial em segurança para Inteligência Artificial, proteção de dados, resposta a incidentes e elevação da cultura de segurança.

  • Threat Intelligence e Threat Hunting: Liderar iniciativas de caça a ameaças (Threat Hunting) e consumir inteligência de ameaças (Threat Intelligence) para antecipar e mitigar ataques direcionados.
  • Cultura de Segurança (Awareness): Arquitetar e sustentar um programa de conscientização em segurança que seja relevante e eficaz, utilizando métricas para demonstrar a sua evolução.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Visão Holística de Segurança: Profundo conhecimento em múltiplas áreas, como Segurança de Redes, Segurança em Nuvem (AWS, Azure), Segurança de Endpoints (EDR/XDR), Gestão de Identidade e Acesso, e Segurança de Aplicações.
  • Frameworks de Mercado: Domínio de frameworks como NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001/27002 e MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Legislação e Conformidade: Conhecimento sólido em leis de proteção de dados (LGPD) e outros regulamentos do setor.
  • Liderança e Comunicação: Habilidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para diferentes públicos (técnico, executivo) e de influenciar decisões estratégicas.
  • Certificações (Diferencial): Certificações de prestígio como CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ou especializações GIAC (GCFA, GCIH) são altamente desejáveis.

title: Pessoa Captadora de Recursos - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Descrição e Responsabilidades

PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA

MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Em MSF, não toleramos qualquer forma de abuso ou comportamento inadequado, seja em relação a colegas de trabalho, pacientes, doadores ou qualquer outra parte envolvida nas nossas operações.

Além disso, buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas.

Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizaremos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem com um ou mais grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans, PcD e pessoas com mais de 40 anos.

CONTEXTO DA VAGA

A captação de novas pessoas doadoras para a organização é o principal recurso para que possamos atuar nos mais diversos contextos de ajuda médica humanitária ao redor do mundo. Dessa forma, as equipes de captação de recursos são fundamentais para que essa atuação seja realizada, pois é através delas, que se vincula financeiramente novas pessoas a nossa causa.

COMO É SER UMA PESSOA CAPTADORA DE RECURSOS EM MSF-BRASIL:

Trabalhar com Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras é muito mais do que abordar pessoas nas ruas — é ser a ponte entre a organização e aquelas que tornam nosso trabalho possível: as pessoas doadoras.

Diariamente, você estará 100% nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro e região metropolitana , abordando ativamente as pessoas para apresentar a missão de MSF e convidá-las a se tornarem doadoras. O trabalho envolve conversar diretamente com o público, explicar o impacto da organização, contornar objeções e garantir novas adesões. Cada abordagem é uma oportunidade de transformar um simples encontro em um ato concreto de apoio às emergências médicas ao redor do mundo.

É um trabalho dinâmico, onde cada dia traz novos desafios e aprendizados. O ambiente é sempre coletivo, repleto de troca com a equipe, compartilhamento de experiências e muita energia. Para brilhar nessa função, é essencial gostar de interagir, ser uma pessoa resiliente, comunicativa, carismática e persistente. Afinal, cada novo doação conquistada representa um impacto real na vida de quem mais precisa.

Se você busca um trabalho com propósito, movimento e desafios diários, essa vaga é para você!

COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

  • Captar novas pessoas doadoras mensais nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro (trabalho 100% externo) , apresentando uma abordagem objetiva e segura, a fim de garantir o ingresso de recursos para MSF;
  • Preservar a imagem de MSF, mantendo uma postura profissional em meio a situações desconfortantes, com intuito de demonstrar segurança e responsabilidade na atuação;
  • Assegurar o cadastro correto das novas pessoas doadoras, preenchendo com atenção e precisão os dados, para garantir o correto ingresso no sistema;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as questões que envolvem a Organização, buscando sempre informação junto aos gestores, assim como nas redes sociais, para maior esclarecimento na captação de novas pessoas doadores.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

  • Português fluente;
  • Ensino médio completo ou cursando graduação;
  • Pacote Office básico.

O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES?

  • Experiências com vendas, captação de recursos, telemarketing, atendimento ao público, terceiro setor.

QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS?

  • Gerenciamento de estresse pois controla reações ultra emotivas e responde com calma;
  • Capacidade de negociação para comunicar aos outros os seus próprios objetivos e demandas;
  • Iniciativa e inovação para identificar oportunidades e problemas;
  • Flexibilidade comportamental para adaptar comportamentos as necessidades da situação.

Venha fazer parte da Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras Brasil!

PRAZO PARA INSCRIÇÃO: 25/06/2026

RETORNO:

Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF! Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno.

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.
